Class Merchant

java.lang.Object
Merchant
public class Merchant extends Object
This class defines the player (the merchant) within the game. It covers the player's financial state in terms of gold, starting capital, target profit. At the same time, it tracks their current location and vessel, and handles the core actions for buying and selling goods. The profit is never stored as it is always computed as the gold minus starting capital

      public Merchant(String name, int capital, double targetProfit)
